tasks.short: Monitor indicators and warning signals for process conformity.

steps.what: Monitor recording instruments, flowmeters, panel lights and warning signals during actual operation
inputs: actual live instruments and warning signals

steps.what: Compare actual recorded values with approved fixed operating limits
inputs: actual recorded instrument values with time, unit and quality
actual approved operating limit table and equipment identifiers
outputs: draft exact-limit comparison and missing-value flags

steps.what: Verify conformity of actual process conditions and assess inconsistent indications
inputs: draft exact-limit comparison and missing-value flags

tasks.design: Configure native fixed-limit comparison views in {OPS_SYSTEM} only where an operator actually performs the comparison manually. The operator retains live observation, listening and final process-conformity judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some actual recorded values may still be compared manually with approved limits.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exact-limit rules can show comparisons and missing-quality flags.
tasks.still_hard: Instrument validity, warning meaning and real process conformity require operator judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognises an unsafe process even when individual values appear within limits.
tasks.altitude: Less fixed comparison; operating attention and judgement remain intact.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native historian views can compare actual values to approved limits; existing alarms and control runtime are not new labour savings.

assumptions: Existing instruments/historian produce actual equipment identifier, timestamp, value, unit and quality flag; actual process owner supplies approved limits/version. Operator verifies context in s1 and full meaning in s3; missing mappings remain manual.
Only demonstrable manual exact comparison is eligible in s2. If native limits/alarms already do it, gross saving is zero; no new monitoring baseline is invented.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. This read/draft view does not send alarms, change setpoints or control equipment. Actual operating actions require separate authority with no saving claimed here.
No record write or report is hidden in monitoring; operating-data recording is the separate task 10496 and is counted once.
unknowns: Is any exact-limit comparison actually manual?
research_questions: Can native comparison reduce manual checking without reducing required observation?

incremental.description: Maintain actual approved limit mappings and quality handling.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 exact comparison; minus 1 upkeep = 14. Half the actual comparison eligible gives 7.5 minus 1 = 6.5. Live observation and conformity judgement stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record actual process conditions, tests and instrument readings.

steps.what: Collect actual field process observations and verify test and instrument source identity
outputs: actual captured field observations and verified source identifiers

steps.what: Transfer actual historian and laboratory values into a draft operating record
inputs: actual captured field observations and verified source identifiers
actual laboratory result identifiers, values and units

steps.what: Record operating data and actual field observations in the existing log
inputs: actual captured field observations and verified source identifiers

steps.what: Check final operating data, units, timestamps and actual field observations
inputs: actual captured field observations and verified source identifiers

steps.what: Commit the checked final operating record

tasks.design: Configure native historian and laboratory information system {OTHER} mappings into the draft log in {OPS_SYSTEM}, with structured fields for actual rounds observations. The operator captures non-instrumented facts, checks the complete final record and commits it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operating logs can duplicate already digital instrument and test values plus equipment references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source mappings and structured rounds fields can reduce exact re-entry.
tasks.still_hard: Actual field observations and invalid or mismatched measurements need operator checks.
tasks.human_edge: The operator distinguishes an instrument reading from a reliable account of actual process conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate operating-data transcription; actual observation remains counted.

evidence.claim: The supplied digest describes AVEVA Mobile Operator feeding rounds data to PI; this supports digital rounds capability, not a local time baseline.
Model knowledge: exact historian and laboratory field mappings can replace duplicate numerical entry where supported.

assumptions: Historian supplies actual equipment, time, value, unit and quality; laboratory owner supplies actual sample/result identity, status and units. Operator verifies matching in s1 and manually captures non-instrumented observations. Missing or invalid imports stay manual in s3.

S2 explicitly replaces existing manual transfer into a draft, not primary observation. S3 cuts only repeated equipment/reference entry; actual field meaning capture stays in its retained fourteen hours.
Test native links first. Already automated logs and import runtime earn no saving; no free new sensor or laboratory digitisation is assumed.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Routine commit retains one percent and uses the existing final record check. Shared capture is counted once with monitoring task 10494.
unknowns: Which values are still entered twice?
Can actual sample and equipment identifiers be matched reliably?
research_questions: Do native draft imports reduce copying after all source and field checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual instrument/test mappings and operating-log fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual operating record and exact equipment/shift log destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30 duplicate value transfer + 20*0.30 repeated field entry = 36; minus 2 upkeep = 34. Half eligible gives 18 minus 2 = 16. Actual field capture, final checks and commit remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Patrol for tanks or troughs at risk of overflowing.

steps.what: Patrol work areas and inspect actual solution levels in tanks or troughs
outputs: actual observed solution levels and overflow signs

steps.what: Assess whether actual solutions are in danger of overflowing
inputs: actual observed solution levels and overflow signs

tasks.design: Keep actual patrol and overflow assessment with the operator. Existing level alarms support the work but provide no demonstrated new reduction in required field coverage.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patrol depends on actual visible tank and trough conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No justified change to the stated patrol work from existing digital records alone.
tasks.still_hard: Foaming, blocked flow and misleading levels require local observation.
tasks.human_edge: The operator sees overflow risks that do not follow from a single instrument value.
tasks.altitude: No proposed reduction in patrol coverage.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: tank patrol involves actual observation; existing digital records do not themselves replace required field checks.

assumptions: Boundary is actual patrol and assessment. No record write, report or send is specified here; operating-data entry is separately represented in task 10496 and any actual issue report in task 10497, counted once rather than added to patrol.
No new level sensors or remote replacement of patrol is assumed. Existing alarms and control runtime earn zero new saving.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. No software change is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Is any required patrol coverage actually replaceable under site procedure?
research_questions: Observe actual patrol and separate logging before considering any coverage change.

incremental.description: No new software for patrol; no new upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual patrol and overflow assessment remain retained; no new saving or upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report and discuss conditions affecting safety, efficiency or quality.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual conditions, observations and relevant operating evidence
outputs: verified actual condition evidence and recipients

steps.what: Prepare and check the actual condition report and technical or supervisory recipients
inputs: verified actual condition evidence and recipients
actual operator explanation of condition and uncertainty
outputs: checked final actual condition report and recipients

loop.purpose: Draft the actual condition report from operator findings
loop.input: Actual checked operating evidence and operator explanation
loop.check: Operator checks condition meaning, omitted uncertainty, unsupported causal claims and actual recipients
loop.stop: Missing actual explanation or two failed revisions returns drafting to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native condition fields and report headings first; actual explanations vary

steps.what: Send the checked final condition report to actual technical or supervisory recipients
inputs: checked final actual condition report and recipients

steps.what: Confer with technical and supervisory personnel to report or resolve actual conditions
inputs: verified actual condition evidence and recipients
outputs: actual discussed findings and chosen next actions

tasks.design: Configure native condition-source lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM} and fixed report fields before a bounded explanation draft in {DOCS}. The operator supplies actual findings, checks the complete final report, sends it separately and personally discusses resolution.
tasks.previous_blocker: Condition discussions can require repeated evidence navigation and written report preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views and bounded source-linked explanation drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Actual safety, efficiency and quality causes and corrective choices require technical discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The operator explains what actually happened and recognises uncertainty in proposed fixes.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence and report preparation; technical discussion stays fully retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native operating-source views and bounded condition-report drafting can reduce preparation; they do not resolve the process condition or authorise a control change.

assumptions: Actual operating records come from counted field/historian recording in task 10496; no new free observation capture is assumed. Operator verifies relevant evidence in s1 and supplies actual explanation/uncertainty within retained s2.
Only actual written report preparation is eligible. Oral-only cases omit s2/s3 and reweight; no new report baseline is invented. Discussion and corrective judgement remain fully retained.
Any implementation, permit or control action is a separate actual authorised action outside this reporting/discussion boundary, with no saving claimed. No outcome is inferred from discussion.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native fields first; already configured reports earn no saving. Routine send retains one percent and uses the existing final report check.
unknowns: Are condition reports actually written before discussion?
How much source navigation is repeated?
research_questions: Does checked report drafting reduce preparation after full meaning review?

incremental.description: Maintain actual condition-source links and report drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked final actual condition report and exact technical/supervisory recipients; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 source navigation + 19*0.30 report drafting = 15.7; minus 1.5 upkeep = 14.2. Half eligible gives 7.85 minus 1.5 = 6.35. Discussion, source meaning and routine send stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Operators retain process attention, patrol, response judgement and technical discussion while actual duplicate values and report preparation may shrink.
skills_to_grow: Native historian and laboratory field mappings
role.ambitious_version: Validate actual manual comparisons, duplicate records and written reports while preserving all operating authority.
